document.abstract: A recently published editorial by a well known writer of the industry is quoted, in which the importance of excellence of projection is stressed. The possibility is discussed of realizing beneficial results through the coöperation of the SMPE; and the opportunity for educational work with organizations representing the projectionists is pointed out, and the manner in which such educational work might be carried on effectively is discussed.
